correctness.rationale: The tangent exact sequence gives \(c(T_X)=(1+H)^{n+c+1}/\prod_i(1+d_iH)\), and Gauss--Bonnet gives the stated coefficient formula after multiplying by the class \([X]=(\prod_i d_i)H^c\). If the total degree is divisible by four, the result is immediate. With exactly one degree congruent to two modulo four, reduction modulo two leaves \(\binom{n+2}{2}\), whose parity is exactly the stated dimension condition. When all degrees are odd, replacing each degree by its sign modulo four and expanding \(((1+t)/(1-t))^f\) to first order in two gives the exact congruence \((-1)^f(n+1+2fn)\). The branches are exhaustive and disjoint. The bundled checker reconstructs the Euler characteristic directly from the Chern series over a broad finite grid.

value.rationale: For a smooth projective complete intersection, the Euler characteristic determines the exceptional middle Betti contribution after the Lefschetz theorem fixes the off-middle cohomology. The theorem therefore gives a complete first two-adic stratification of a basic topological invariant across all dimensions, codimensions, and multidegrees. It identifies a clean geometric parity regime—exactly even dimension with all defining degrees odd—and sharply separates the cases with one versus at least two powers of two. The result is structural and all-parameter rather than a finite congruence table.
